QGC.MetaData.Facts.name: localMediaStorageEnabled
QGC.MetaData.Facts.shortDesc: Save camera photos and videos locally
QGC.MetaData.Facts.longDesc: When enabled, camera photo and recording actions also save media to this device independently of gimbal SD card storage.

QGC.MetaData.Facts.name: mt11SdkHost
QGC.MetaData.Facts.longDesc: Controls UniPod MT11 camera commands only. This address is independent of RTSP URL 2 under Video settings.

QGC.MetaData.Facts.name: mavlinkAutoVideoStream
QGC.MetaData.Facts.longDesc: When enabled, QGC uses the video URI reported by MAVLink and locks manual video source editing. Restart QGC after changing this option.

QGC.MetaData.Facts.name: uniRcChannelControlEnabled
QGC.MetaData.Facts.longDesc: Android opens the UniRC SDK Serial 2 interface and maps CH9 to A8 Mini continuous zoom and the CH10 press edge to the shared MAVLink Gimbal Manager center action.

QGC.MetaData.Facts.name: uniRcSdkSerialPort
QGC.MetaData.Facts.longDesc: UniGCS must route the UniRC SDK to Serial 2. When this device is /dev/ttyHS0, Android Bluetooth must be fully off before QGC can open the shared UART.
